whatWeSee.title: What Replywise can see
whatWeSee.line1: Nothing you type leaves your phone unless you tap Reply or Polish.
whatWeSee.line2: When you tap, only the copied message or your draft goes to our AI provider, processed in the EU.

age.under18Stop: Replywise is for adults. AI replies are off.

signIn.notice: We use your email only to sign you in and send account emails.
